propositions: The packaged CLI overview help (overview.txt) incorrectly states unlink accepts no relation argument, contradicting the current library and CLI that accept an optional relation selector.
The maintained ticket-model documentation (docs/ticket-model.md) documents unlink without describing the optional relation argument added in commit 73abb5805f.
The event-schema documentation fails to distinguish the optional relation selector in the unlink operation from the link_uuid-targeted UNLINK event cancellation payload.
Omitting the relation argument should retain the historical most-recent fallback behavior, which both the overview and ticket-model must document.
An explicitly specified canonical relation should remove only that specific relation while preserving other active relations on the source-target pair.
